key_insight: Prompt tuning failures often stem from shifts in the visual encoder's foreground attention; by conditioning prompts on the model's foreground view, FVG-PT adaptively aligns text prompts with the visual focus to restore correct predictions.
problem_solved: Standard CLIP-based prompt tuning overlooks changes in internal attention maps of the visual encoder, causing misalignment between visual features and text prompts and leading to degraded downstream performance.
method: Detect and extract foreground view / attention maps from the pretrained visual encoder during tuning.
Generate or adapt prompt tokens conditioned on the extracted foreground view to better align text embeddings with the model's current visual focus.
Apply the adaptive, plug-and-play prompt module to CLIP-style VLMs for efficient downstream adaptation without heavy model finetuning.
impact: FVG-PT makes prompt tuning more robust and reliable by closing the gap between visual attention and textual prompts, improving few-shot and transfer performance while keeping adaptation lightweight for practitioners.

paper_title: FVG-PT: Adaptive Foreground View-Guided Prompt Tuning for Vision-Language Models
paper_authors: Haoyang Li, Liang Wang, Siyu Zhou, Jiacheng Sun, Jing Jiang
